FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE BADDEGAMA PRADESHIYASABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE(CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of the return member of Baddegama Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of being ceased tobe a member of the party ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the United National Freedom Front, the recognized political party to whichPunyarathna Wickramasingha the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66A(1) of the aforesaid ordinance,to decide upon returned member if United National Freedom Front who belongs to such party and is not disqualified underSection 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and who shall be declared selected as a member within a period ofthirty (30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his decision tonominate Upasaka Dewayalage Ajith Prema Kumar to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE I, Kanda Uda Chandralal, Returning Officer of the Baddegama Pradeshiya Sabha, acting interms of section 66A(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that UpasakaDewayalage Ajith Prema Kumar was selected as the member of the Baddegama Pradeshiya Sabha.
K. U. CHANDRALAL,Returning Officer,Baddegama Pradeshiya Sabha.
